cases.translation: Sing to the Lord a new song.
cases.explain: The verb воспойте (sing) with the dative object governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Возвещайте славу Его среди ___, чудеса Его среди всех людей.
cases.translation: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.
cases.explain: The preposition среди (among) governing the genitive case.

cases.sentence: потому что велик Господь и достоин беспредельной ___.
cases.translation: because the Lord is great and greatly to be praised.
cases.explain: The adjective достоин (worthy) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Он внушает страх более всех ___, все боги народов идолы.
cases.translation: He is to be feared above all gods; for all the gods of the peoples are idols.
cases.explain: The comparative construction требует генитива — above/more than all gods takes the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Слава и величие перед Ним, сила и великолепие в Его ___.
cases.translation: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) indicating location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Воздайте Господу ___, воздайте Ему славу и силу.
cases.translation: Ascribe to the Lord, you families of the nations, ascribe to him glory and strength.
cases.explain: Народы is the object of the imperative verb воздайте (ascribe to), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Несите дар и идите во дворы ___.
cases.translation: Bring an offering and come into his courts.
cases.explain: The genitive possessive construction; the courts belong to God.

cases.sentence: Скажите среди ___, Господь справит, прочно мир утвержден.
cases.translation: Say among the nations, the Lord reigns, the world is firmly established.
cases.explain: The preposition среди (among) governing the genitive case.

reading.question: What does the psalmist call people to do at the beginning of this psalm?
options: Sing a new song to the Lord
reading.correct: Sing a new song to the Lord
reading.explain: The opening command is 'Воспойте Господу новую песню' — Sing to the Lord a new song.

reading.ru: Он внушает страх более всех богов, все боги народов идолы, а Господь сотворил небеса.
reading.question: What distinction does the psalmist make between the Lord and other gods?
options: The Lord is feared above all gods, other gods are idols, but the Lord created the heavens
All gods are equal in power
The gods of the nations are real
The Lord did not create anything
reading.correct: The Lord is feared above all gods, other gods are idols, but the Lord created the heavens
reading.explain: The text contrasts 'Он внушает страх более всех богов' with 'все боги народов идолы' and affirms 'Господь сотворил небеса.'

reading.ru: Слава и величие перед Ним, сила и великолепие в Его святилище.
reading.question: What attributes or qualities surround God according to this verse?
options: Honor, majesty, strength, and beauty in his sanctuary
reading.correct: Honor, majesty, strength, and beauty in his sanctuary
reading.explain: The text lists 'Слава и величие' (honor and majesty) and 'сила и великолепие' (strength and beauty) in his sanctuary.

reading.ru: Воздайте Господу славу, присущую Его имени.
reading.question: What are people commanded to give to the Lord?
options: The glory due to his name
reading.correct: The glory due to his name
reading.explain: The imperative is 'Воздайте Господу славу, присущую Его имени' — Give to the Lord the glory belonging to his name.

reading.ru: Да возвеселятся небеса и возлекует земля, да вошумит море и все, что в нем.
reading.question: What cosmic elements does the psalmist call to rejoice?
options: The heavens, earth, sea, and all that is in it
Only the stars in the sky
reading.correct: The heavens, earth, sea, and all that is in it
reading.explain: The text invokes 'небеса' (heavens), 'земля' (earth), and 'море и все, что в нем' (sea and all that is in it).

reading.ru: Да возликуют все деревья лесные перед Господом, потому что идет, идет он судить землю.
reading.question: Why should the trees of the forest shout for joy?
options: Because the Lord comes to judge the earth
Because people will cut them down
reading.correct: Because the Lord comes to judge the earth
reading.explain: The explanation is given: 'потому что идет, идет он судить землю' — because he comes to judge the earth.
